# truenas_cloud_backup_run (Action)

Runs a cloud backup (restic) task now (cloud_backup.sync). A second run of the same task while one is running waits for it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Run a cloud backup task now (Terraform 1.14+).
# id is the numeric task id — reference the managing resource rather than
# hardcoding it (or discover it with `midclt call cloud_backup.query`).
action "truenas_cloud_backup_run" "example" {
  config {
    id = truenas_cloud_backup.offsite.id
    # A first backup can take hours: start it and return.
    wait = false
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Cloud backup task id (truenas_cloud_backup.<name>.id).

### Optional

- `wait` (Boolean) Wait for the job to finish (default true). Set false to start it and return immediately without polling.
